labels.text: Tap to record, hold for push-to-talk

S49.01.needs: a microphone, phone width or Mac/iPhone with mic permission; the mic button only appears when Voice Input is on and the on-device recognizer is available
S49.01.note: The mic is hidden when Voice Input is off or the on-device recognizer is missing (onDeviceRecognizerGuaranteed in VoiceInputButton.tsx); the Mac may not show a mic button at all.
steps: Open Settings, then Voice, and turn on "Voice Input" (it is a toggle row).
Open any chat so the message field and its controls show.
Tap the microphone button (idle label "Tap to record, hold for push-to-talk").
Speak a short sentence, then tap "Stop recording" (the square).
Compare: the spoken words should appear as text in the message field.
S49.01.where: Settings > Voice > turn on "Voice Input"; then open any chat and tap the microphone button in the message field

S49.02.note: The square "Stop recording" inserts; the arrow "Send recording" sends immediately, which is the opposite of an editable-first flow, so test the square. I did not read the insert handler body (handleTranscription) in full.
steps: Open any chat with Voice Input turned on in Settings > Voice.
Tap the microphone button and speak a sentence with a mistake in it.
Tap "Stop recording" (the square, not the arrow).
Tap inside the message field and edit a word, then compare: the transcript should be there and editable, and nothing should be sent yet.
S49.02.where: Open a chat > microphone button > "Stop recording" (square); the text lands in the message field

S49.03.note: The row opens a language picker in the same screen; a separate screen with the title "Voice & Language" also exists (src/features/settings/voice-language/index.tsx). I did not verify which one the row opens in the UI.
steps: Open Settings, then Voice.
Tap the row labelled "Speech language" and pick a different language from the list.
Turn on Voice Input if it is off, open a chat, and dictate a sentence in the new language.
Compare: the transcript should be in that language. The choice is stored per Local and Cloud mode.

S49.05.note: An empty transcript is dropped silently (VoiceInputButton.tsx only delivers text that is not blank), so an empty result shows nothing in the field.
steps: Turn on Voice Input, open a chat, and tap the microphone button.
Speak one full sentence, then tap "Stop recording".
Wait for the processing state to finish.
Compare: the full sentence should appear once as the final text. If nothing was heard, the alert "Didn't catch that" appears instead.
S49.05.where: Open a chat > microphone button > speak > "Stop recording"; the final transcript appears in the message field

S49.06.note: Retry means a new recording, not a re-transcription of the old audio, because audio is not kept. Which failures trigger this alert was not fully traced.
steps: Turn on Voice Input, open a chat, and tap the microphone button.
Stay silent for a few seconds, or speak so it cannot be heard, then tap "Stop recording".
When the alert "Didn't catch that" appears, tap "Try again".
Compare: recording starts again straight away without you retyping anything. The alert says the audio is not saved, so you must speak again.
S49.06.where: Open a chat > microphone button > stay silent or fail > alert "Didn't catch that" > "Try again"

steps: Turn on Voice Input, open a chat, and type a few words so you can see the field's current text.
Tap the microphone button and speak a sentence.
Tap "Cancel recording" (the X button on the left of the recording bar).
Compare: the recording stops, nothing is added to the message field, and nothing is sent.
S49.07.where: Open a chat > microphone button > while recording tap "Cancel recording" (the X)

S49.09.needs: an iPhone with a short audio recording saved in the Files app
S49.09.note: Found the batch path: TranscribeIntent.swift (title "Transcribe with AGI") hands an audio file to the app, and app/_layout.tsx (case 'transcribe') opens app/(app)/voice.tsx, which calls transcribeAudioFile in one request (voice.tsx lines 324-358, voiceInput.ts non-streaming path). I could not confirm from the code how a person starts that intent on the phone (the Shortcuts app or the Share sheet), so the path is left empty. Searched: rg for audioUri, transcribe and Transcribe with AGI in apps/mobile.

S49.10.needs: a microphone; an iPhone with on-device speech recognition for the live text
S49.10.note: Live partial text comes from interimResults in VoiceInputButton's recording path (VoiceInputButton.tsx onPartialTranscript to setLiveTranscript). The separate voice conversation mode (LiveVoiceBar.tsx, "Open Voice Companion" in Settings > Voice) is a different streaming feature, not the composer dictation; I did not confirm the on-screen rendering of the live text.
steps: Turn on Voice Input in Settings > Voice, open a chat.
Tap the microphone button (the label becomes "Tap to stop recording").
Speak slowly for several seconds without tapping anything.
Compare: words should appear in the message field while you are still speaking, before "Stop recording" is tapped.
S49.10.where: Settings > Voice > turn on "Voice Input"; open a chat > microphone button > speak; words appear in the field before you stop

labels.text: Your voice is transcribed on this device and never recorded.

S49.17.needs: a microphone; the sheet only appears the first time, so use an account or device that has not seen dictation yet
S49.17.note: There is no separate checkbox: agreement is the "Continue" button. The disclosure shown depends on the mode (on-device or live); I did not confirm which mode dictation passes to the sheet.
steps: Turn on Voice Input in Settings > Voice, then open a chat.
Tap the microphone button for the first time (the sheet only appears once on this account or device).
Read the sheet: title "Dictation", the line "Speak instead of typing. Your words appear as text in your message.", and the disclosure line.
Compare: the disclosure should say where audio goes. Tap "Continue" to start recording; the sheet's X closes it without starting.
S49.17.where: Settings > Voice > turn on "Voice Input"; open a chat > tap the microphone button the first time > "Dictation" sheet > "Continue"

S49.25.needs: a chat with at least one message
S49.25.note: There is no export that is only the dictation transcript: the export covers the whole conversation. The exact trigger for the chat action menu was not traced.
steps: Open a chat that contains a message written with dictation.
Open the chat's action menu and tap "Export".
Tap "Export as Markdown" (or "Export as Text").
Compare: the share sheet opens with a file that contains the dictated words in the conversation.
S49.25.where: Open a chat that has a dictated message > the chat's action menu > "Export" > "Export as Text" or "Export as Markdown" or "Export as PDF"

S49.27.note: No recording or dictation retention or delete control was found. Audio is not kept (ChatInput.tsx: "Audio isn't saved, so say it again."). Transcripts are chat messages, so they follow chat deletion. The only "Data retention" row is cloud-only (src/features/settings/cloud-privacy/index.tsx:44). Searched rg for retention, recording delete and transcript delete in apps/mobile/app and src.

S49.30.note: Searched rg -i undo in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ChatInput.tsx and apps/mobile/src/features/voice: no match. The dictated text is inserted by the app's own state update, so whether the normal undo action reverts it was not verified from code.
